# Warn before simultaneous tab edits overwrite newer work

## What & Why
Cross-tab updates now keep saved cards fresh, but simultaneous edits still use last-write-wins behavior. A clear conflict signal would help users avoid losing a newer change made in another tab.

## Done looks like
- An open edit form detects when its saved entry changes in another tab
- The user can keep the newer remote version or explicitly overwrite it
- The choice is covered for both answers and applications
